title: Kissner tells Steven Schiff, who launches the Roswell GAO probe
summary: UAPGerb tells of Kissner tells Steven Schiff, who launches the Roswell GAO probe, about 1995 at New Mexico / Washington, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh indeed uh Jay Ander Kissner allegedly in 19 1995 told other New Mexico state rep uh Steven Schiff about this.

plain: A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says on a podcast that in 1995 a New Mexico state lawmaker, J. Andrew Kissner, reportedly told another New Mexico lawmaker, Steven Schiff, about something to do with Roswell, the New Mexico town long tied to stories of a crashed craft. According to this telling, that is what led to an inquiry into Roswell by the GAO, the investigative and auditing office of the US Congress.
